request_summary: Show the added client Bol account on its own tab instead of combining it with the existing Bankhoes account worklist.
excluded_pages: Bol credential values, OAuth tokens, retailer account settings, and retailer writes
Turso schema/data changes and non-ampere tables
Other repositories, Vercel projects, or browser storage for operational state
active_rules: Keep browser access on same-origin /api routes and all credentials server-side.
Keep the FIFO Enter-terminated automatic-refocus scan loop fail closed.
The primary account remains the default operational context.
Source-qualified orders, shipments, totals, accepted records, and cancellations may appear only in their matching account tab.
Source-unqualified STOP records remain visible as shared safety review rather than being silently hidden by a tab.
A matching tracking code across both sources remains an existing global fail-closed condition until an explicitly approved persistence-key migration exists.
Visual work requires current desktop and mobile inspection bound to the released deployment.
external_account_policy: Use only the already approved Vercel bol-ampere-scanning project and only after local verification.
content_truth_policy: All account-specific quantities and package rows come from the selected source snapshot; tab labels are fixed non-secret operational labels.
